entities.summary: Stephen Tomlin was a British artist associated with the Bloomsbury Set. He was the youngest son of the judge and law lord Thomas, Lord Tomlin of Ash. Stephen Tomlin was a painters & sculptors from London (1901-03-02, London–1937-01-05). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
